_about: One asset per ROOM_FIXTURES (REF-013) register counter row (RI 1.5 rows 98/101, REF-011; RI 8.1; DEC-039). Local frame: staff side -Y (asset front, shows the cabinet construction), customer face +Y, run along X; ART yaws the asset so +Y points to the RF 'faces' direction, and plan_axis_x = the plan direction local +X then points along (faces S: -x west; W: -y north; N: +x east). Station local_x_m = RF POS_xx pos_ft minus the RF counter centre, measured along plan_axis_x. Every value below is cited in _sources.

_sources.length_m / depth_m / height_m: RF size_ft of the variant's `rf` row (ROOM_FIXTURES after REF-013): depth 2.2 ft North, 2.5 ft EastReturn/South/SouthWestReturn (= TI A940 POS top 2'-6"); height 2.833 ft = TI 6.4 34 in max AFF (0.8636). North's 2.2 ft vs the TI 2'-6" POS top: RF used, conflict GAP-PROC-23

_sources.toe_h_m / toe_recess_m: TI 6.4 4 in toe base, 2 in recess

_sources.gable_t_m: GAP-PROC-22 (3/4 in carcass board, construction convention)

_sources.drawer_cabinet_w_m: TI 6.4 detail 11 two-drawer POS cabinet (two equal drawers) under each monitor; width GAP-PROC-22

_sources.colors.Walnut_WD1: TI 6.4 WD-1 walnut veneer / PL-1 walnut laminate fronts; value = a typical dark walnut tone (linear), shade not measured (GAP-PROC-22)

Both ends exposed (the SW return meets the staff side, not an end)

RF Counter_Register_SouthWestReturn 2.5 x 4.5 ft centred (16.53, 24.75): x 15.28-17.78, y 22.49-26.99, faces E (REF-013, A901 printed 2'-6" width + A011/A012 vectors). No register. Face finish has no source: neutral grey GAP-PROC-24. Small closed return: tri guide lowered (DEC-114)
